thread:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH CPU/GPU OOMs observed on serving shard eu-west1-g-rt-08. Multiple decode streaming containers restarting. PD: INCIDENT-5912 https://pd.example/INC-5912
alice_sre: seeing continuous cuda OOM logs, nodes flapping. killing affected pods for now to stop crashloop.
ben_runtime: attaching logs -- decode kernel shows: `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY at decode_kernel.cu:456` and then `terminate: process crashed (oom)`.
alice_sre: kubectl snippet: `kubectl get pods -n rtd eu-west1-g-rt-08-*` -> 6/8 are CrashLoopBackOff.
dave_oncall: confirmed traffic spike to streaming endpoints with unusually long generations. likely runaway generation; header analysis incoming.
carmen_prod: customer impact check: initial look shows 2 customers with elevated 5xxs: AcmeCorp (chat) and nestor-ai (batch streaming).
ellen_cs: on it, will notify AcmeCorp as soon as we know scope.
ben_runtime: got a sample request from logs: `headers: {"X-Max-Tokens": "0", "client": "acme-prod"}`. max_tokens=0 interpreted as unlimited in older router. that's the trigger.
alice_sre: that aligns with decode loops—generator doesn't hit token cap. KV growth, eventual GPU OOM.
ben_runtime: quick mitigation: pushing router hotfix to coerce max_tokens<=4096 and default 512 when missing. preparing rollout to eu-west1 only.
faythe_eng: suggest immediate soft-throttle: set per-client concurrency cap for AcmeCorp and nestor-ai to 2. adding temporary routing rule.
dave_oncall: applied concurrency cap for those clients on eu-west1; monitoring.
incident-bot: Deploy started by ben_runtime: rtr-hotpatch/max-tokens-coerce -> canary on eu-west1 (2 nodes).
alice_sre: after node-side throttle + router fix, OOMs dropped from ~10/min to 0. pods stabilizing; restarting recovered ones.
ben_runtime: pushed additional guard in decode service: if effective_max_tokens > 5000 then drop request with 4xx and log. shipping to canary now.
carmen_prod: estimated customer impact: ~2300 requests dropped over 9 minutes (most long-running streaming connections terminated). CS: AcmeCorp ~1.1k dropped, Nestor-ai ~700, remaining misc.
ellen_cs: emailing customers with temporary mitigation note and ETA for permanent fix.
dave_oncall: handing to ben_runtime for follow-up and postmortem. Ben, please take over on-call at 1710600200.
ben_runtime: taking over. plan: 1) confirm router patch in all regions, 2) add server-side header validation / reject ambiguous max_tokens, 3) add telemetry alert for max_tokens==0 header counts.
faythe_eng: will open a quick PR to the router: enforce header schema and add warning metrics. 1-2 hour patch.
alice_sre: infrastructure action: quarantined eu-west1-g-rt-08 for deeper debug; rotated affected shard to spare nodes to reduce blast radius.
ben_runtime: rolling pin of router and decode guard completed for eu-west1. will run load replay against canary to validate.
carmen_prod: CS requested log excerpt to include in customer note. attaching anonymized error sample.
ellen_cs: sent notice to AcmeCorp + Nestor-ai; scheduled bridge if they want deeper technical debriefs.
dave_oncall: summary for handoff: root cause - client-sent max_tokens=0 + router historical behavior treating 0 as unlimited -> runaway streaming -> KV/cache growth -> GPU OOM -> pod restarts -> request drops. mitigations: router hotpatch, per-client throttle, server-side max_tokens guard, shard rotation. customer comms in flight.
ben_runtime: I'll own the postmortem. immediate follow-ups: (a) merge router schema PR, (b) add unit test for header edge-case, (c) add alert for max_tokens anomalous distribution, (d) run a small scale chaos test to ensure OOMs are contained by per-client caps.
faythe_eng: created ticket RT-1249 for router schema + metrics.
alice_sre: operational follow-ups: review auto-evac logic to avoid rotating same shard for >2 incidents/day.
ben_runtime: logging final: node eu-west1-g-rt-08 showing stable <30% GPU mem after mitigations, no OOM for last 10m. closing pager but leaving incident thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
